audit.finding: One common soil-water contract is reused; no alternate SWAP kernel is introduced.
The view has no files, paths, parsing or file-unit dependencies.
The view contains physical hydraulic state only and does not mix parameters, forcing, numerical configuration or results.
The view is explicitly transient and is not added to persistent per-column state.
No Newton vectors, Jacobians, constitutive intermediates or solver scratch are exposed.
F-SI17 defines logical snapshot semantics only; F-MR may later implement pooled/batched access without changing the contract.
Transaction ownership remains F-KT; F-SI17 cannot commit or mutate physical state.
Snapshot construction is deterministic and A/B/A repeatability is tested.
The view contains no time or calendar assumption.
No coupling-window semantics are introduced.
Coupling transaction and predictor-corrector behavior are untouched.
Groundwater interface head/flux contract is untouched.
No flux or mass accounting path is modified.
Interface sensitivities are untouched.
No coupling run-count policy is changed.
The view is not persistent and can be materialized only when needed; high-scale runtime binding remains F-MR ownership.
No MODFLOW-cell mapping assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose composition is untouched.
No component transition storage is changed.
The view is built from solver-neutral soil_water_physical_state_t and is not tied to one Richards implementation.
The seam enables process physics reuse without duplicating hydraulic solver internals.
This unit directly enforces the invariant: process consumers receive pressure head, water content and selected indicators without HeadCalc internals.
No physics option or execution policy is altered.
No solver-cost or fallback behavior is altered.
Reference solver behavior remains unchanged; F-SI17 only observes a supplied physical state.
Runtime solver diagnostics are untouched; view validation fails closed through an explicit ok result.
No view memory exists until a caller requests a snapshot; it is not stored for inactive processes or columns.
System composition and tile ownership remain outside the kernel/view.
No midnight, one-day, file-format or MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
Contract, source-bound tests, CI evidence and this invariant audit are persisted before downstream admission.

holds: Committed-versus-candidate/trial provenance is not encoded by the view itself; F-MR must bind the qualified view to committed state for F-PM03 irrigation decisions.
F-SI17 does not qualify irrigation equations, irrigation state, irrigation mass accounting or runtime composition.
F-SI16 prescribed bottom-head work remains an independent lineage and is not merged here.
